LESSONS:
- An ENOTEMPTY in a vitest afterEach rmSync on temp git repos has a cause: Jordan's global git config sets trace2.eventtarget to the git-ai daemon socket. After each git command returns, the daemon writes .git/ai and refs/notes/ai into ANY repo, the test fixtures included. Make fixture git hermetic with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, in the helper env and in the script-under-test env. governance-branch.test.ts already does this. Other harness/scripts tests that init repos have the same exposure: fleet-map, pr-freeze, worktree-deps, local-path, commit-trailers.
- Re-publishing state through a promise chain: capture the value when you enqueue it, never in a thunk that reads it when it runs. Otherwise older queued sends land after the newest. A failed send must check "superseded?" BEFORE it waits to retry, because the abort signal may have been replaced before the attempt started. Reviewers write exactly these interleavings, so test them with a held first request (holdActivity in store.test.mjs).
- Cost rows: a retry loop with a sleep IS a new loop and timer, so say so. State caps per call versus per outage. Per-job floors scale per owner as the sum over jobs. Rate per-tick SQL reads (100 ms tick means 10/s).
- Adding a field to an OMP activity post breaks older daemons (deny_unknown_fields returns a bare 422). Strip the field and resend; see daemon-http.ts publishActivity.
